# Synthetic font fixtures

`color-emoji-colr-v0.ttf` and `color-emoji-sbix.ttf` are generated by
`generate_color_emoji_fixtures.py`. Their glyph outlines, palette values, and
bitmap pixels were authored for OdyTTY's tests; they do not subset or contain
data from an installed font.

Regenerate them with Python 3, FontTools, and Pillow:

```sh
python3 tests/fixtures/fonts/generate_color_emoji_fixtures.py
```

The COLR fixture exercises two translucent static v0 layers. The sbix fixture
pins the established bitmap-first source order and straight-alpha to
premultiplied-RGBA conversion.
